purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations for NYC-area airports (origin stations EWR, JFK, LGA) for downstream join against flight and scheduling tables keyed on station and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to attach weather conditions to flight records; consumers should expect nulls in wind_dir, wind_speed, pressure, and especially wind_gust (74.6% null) and must handle them explicitly rather than assume zero or average values.
limitations: wind_gust is missing for about three quarters of rows and pressure is missing for about 11.5% of rows, so any aggregate or model relying on those fields will have reduced coverage; wind_dir and wind_speed have small but nonzero null rates as well. No duplicate rows were found in bronze (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), so no dedupe logic was applied.
